description: This file defines the AssetFragment class, a UI component for an Android app that displays a photo asset received from a phone. It manages an ImageView element and provides a method to update its image.

classes.name: AssetFragment
classes.description: A Fragment subclass that displays a photo asset received from the phone and provides a method to set its background image.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the asset_fragment layout and initializes the ImageView for displaying the photo.

methods.name: setBackgroundImage
methods.description: Sets the Bitmap image to the ImageView to display the received asset.
